rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a significant, usually organized long-purpose journey, including a military or naval one.

example.english: They spent a year preparing for the expedition to the South Pole.
example.traditional: 佢哋今次去南極遠征，準備咗成年。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 heoi3 naam4 gik6 jyun5 zing1 zeon2 bei6 zo2 sing4 nin4

rows.note: Use this when referring to the team or group of people making the expedition rather than to the journey itself.

example.english: That expedition team is made up of ten scientists.
example.traditional: 嗰支遠征隊由十個科學家組成。
example.jyutping: go2 zi1 jyun5 zing1 deoi6 jau4 sap6 go3 fo1 hok6 gaa1 zou2 sing4
